description: Creates a full or partial refund in Stripe, targeting either a specific charge ID or a payment intent ID.

amount.description: Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., 1000 for $10.00 USD) to refund. If omitted, a full refund is issued. Cannot exceed the charge's remaining refundable amount.
amount.title: Amount

charge.description: Identifier of the charge to refund. Required if `payment_intent` is not provided.
charge.title: Charge

metadata.description: Key-value pairs to attach to the refund, for storing structured information like order numbers or internal IDs.

payment_intent.description: Identifier of the PaymentIntent to refund. Required if `charge` is not provided.

reason.description: Reasons for issuing a refund in Stripe.
reason.title: RefundReason

refund_application_fee.description: Refund the application fee? If true, full refunds refund the entire fee; partials refund proportionally. Applies if the original charge had an application fee.
refund_application_fee.title: Refund Application Fee

reverse_transfer.description: Reverse an associated transfer? Reversal is proportional to refund amount. Applies if the original charge had a reversible transfer.
reverse_transfer.title: Reverse Transfer

CreateRefundResponse.description:
Stripe Refund object returned when creating a refund.

Refund objects allow you to refund a previously created charge that isn't refunded yet.
Funds are refunded to the credit or debit card that's initially charged.

amount.description: Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents) being refunded.
amount.title: Amount

balance_transaction.description: Balance transaction that describes the impact on your account balance.
balance_transaction.title: Balance Transaction

charge.description: ID of the charge that was refunded.
charge.title: Charge

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.
description.title: Description

failure_balance_transaction.description: Balance transaction that reverses the initial balance transaction if the refund fails.
failure_balance_transaction.title: Failure Balance Transaction

failure_reason.description: Reason for refund failure (e.g., lost_or_stolen_card, expired_or_canceled_card).
failure_reason.title: Failure Reason

id.description: Unique identifier for the refund object.

instructions_email.description: Email address to send refund instructions for payment methods that are not supported for programmatic refunds.

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object for storing additional structured information.

next_action.description: Details required to continue the refund process when status is requires_action.

payment_intent.description: ID of the PaymentIntent that was refunded.

source_transfer_reversal.description: Transfer reversal when the charge being refunded came from another Stripe account.
